summary: Don't just see a changing planet, hear it. Seeing is only one part of the experience, hearing is what adds a new dimension. 'Earth Beat' takes NASA data, shows a visualization and adds a sonification for enhanced perception. Earth Beat is an engine that transforms weather values to sound. It'll help people to not just see but also hear the beats of a changing Earth.
